mentions.name: Hammock
mentions.description: An Emacs-like editor that uses Clojure instead of Emacs Lisp as its extension language. It has a C kernel and embeds libsci (Small Clojure Interpreter, built with GraalVM), so it has no Java dependency at runtime.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on an Emacs-like editor that uses Clojure instead of Emacs Lisp. It has a C kernel and then uses libsci (Small Clojure Interpreter, built with GraalVM, so it has no Java dependency at runtime).

I call it Hammock, in honor of Rich Hickey's "Hammock Driven Design"
